system_texts: Financial objectives are unclear or missing with no consensus on a revenue target, and there is pricing risk as the proposed price point may not align with market expectations or willingness to pay.

There are usability and speech recognition challenges: 35% say speech recognition is too difficult to use; 50% say they can't find the remote half the time; ambient noise and on-screen dialogue can cause misinterpretation of commands requiring robust filtering; training for voice commands may be time-consuming for users; speech recognition could impact battery life, necessitating wireless charging or solar cells; and there is uncertainty whether speech recognition should rely on one-word commands or allow longer phrases.

No final decision on which features to include has been reached; the group is debating whether to start with all features or prune later, and remote UI issues include too many buttons and unclear labels along with concerns about findability and search capability; time pressure ended the discussion with important decisions unresolved.
The reason we were asked to prepare this slide is unclear.
gold_texts: The team did not resolve whether to design all suggested features first or prune them before developing the concept; discussion was deferred when meeting time ran out.
The desired price/feature tradeoff and management's willingness to fund a more innovative product remained unclear.
